tree.text: The parties to an arbitration proceeding shall be entitled to participate in the selection of the arbitrator.
The arbitrator shall be a neutral who meets the criteria of section 573 of this title.

notes.text: Amendments1992—Pub. L. 102–354, § 3(b)(2), renumbered section 587 of this title as this section. Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 102–354, § 3(b)(3), substituted “section 573” for “section 583”.

ancestors.heading: ALTERNATIVE MEANS OF DISPUTE RESOLUTION IN THE ADMINISTRATIVE PROCESS
